context: M13 o8. Rita's bar after close. Prints laid out on the bar under a lamp.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Brannock taking. Wurtz with the park boy. Brannock again. You've got a file, sugar.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Three pictures. Three men who'd lose everything if I mailed them anywhere.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Or three men who'd make you disappear first. Mail them nowhere. Yet.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule nine: a picture you've never shown is worth more than one you have.
